text: That when Babylon comes and attacks, that Edom will perhaps defend Babylon but defend Israel against Babylon, but that's not what Edom does. Look at the text. Edom actually says, "Destroy it down to its foundations," and then there is Babylon. And I've already shared what Babylon did when Babylon moved into Israel and dragged people away. That they they tried to destroy an entire generation. It was ancient warfare and it was disgusting.
